title: Inflation report due before the market opens
summary: The government is scheduled to publish its October consumer price report at 8:30 a.m. Eastern today. It shows how fast everyday prices are rising.
why: Prices rising fast can push interest rates higher, and higher rates often hurt growth stocks. A calmer number can help stocks. Nobody knows the result until it comes out.

title: NVIDIA sets its earnings call for November 17
summary: NVIDIA announced it will report results for the quarter that ended October 25 on Tuesday, November 17. The conference call starts at 5 p.m. Eastern.
why: Earnings reports are when a company shows its real sales and profit. Stocks often move a lot that day, so it is a good date to watch if you want to learn how earnings work.

title: Wall Street rebounds from last week's slump
summary: US stocks climbed on Monday after a rough stretch the week before. Lower oil prices helped the mood.
why: When oil gets cheaper, it can ease worries about inflation. One good day is nice, but it does not prove the slump is over.

title: NVIDIA falls while other chip makers jump
summary: NVIDIA slid on Monday even as most chip companies rose sharply.
why: A company can go its own way when there is news about just that company. It is a reminder that owning one stock is riskier than owning many.
